summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by POSCO HOLDINGS INC., a foreign private issuer, reporting a routine change in the shareholding of its largest shareholder, National Pension Service. As of June 18, 2026, NPS held 6,576,661 common shares (8.30% of issued shares). The filing is a regulatory notification of a passive ownership change, not a special situation. No transaction, offer, or corporate action is disclosed. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, or advisors mentioned. This is a routine current report under Rule 13a-16, not a special situation.
